title: cotyledon paniculata
intro: Cotyledon paniculata, commonly known as "Benguema" or "Spoon Plant", is a succulent plant species belonging to the Crassulaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cotyledon paniculata include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower fever, and alleviate pain, making it a valuable remedy in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
